track.name: marketing
track.label: Growth & Marketing
track.summary: Teaches how to attract, convert, and retain customers using a full-funnel toolkit — positioning, SEO and content, paid acquisition, email and lifecycle marketing, and growth experimentation — the skills that turn a good product into one that actually grows.

phases.title: Marketing Fundamentals & Positioning
phases.description: Learn who you're selling to and why they should care — the marketing mix, ideal customer profiles, value propositions, and brand basics that every channel-specific tactic builds on.

phases.title: Content & SEO
phases.description: Learn to earn organic traffic — how search engines rank content, how to find the keywords worth targeting, and how to plan content that actually gets found.

phases.title: Paid Acquisition
phases.description: Learn to buy attention efficiently — Google Search, Display and Video campaigns, plus paid social on Meta and LinkedIn.

phases.title: Email & Lifecycle Marketing
phases.description: Learn to nurture and retain the people you've already reached — inbound marketing fundamentals, email sequences, segmentation, and lifecycle-stage messaging.

phases.title: Growth & Experimentation
phases.description: Learn to grow systematically instead of by guesswork — A/B testing, growth loops, the AARRR funnel, and the growth-hacking mindset behind fast-growing products.

phases.title: Analytics for Marketers
phases.description: Learn to prove what's working — Google Analytics 4 fundamentals and the attribution models that connect a conversion back to the marketing that caused it.

topics.title: Marketing Fundamentals & the Marketing Mix

topics.title: On-Page SEO & Content Strategy
topics.description: Optimize a page for both readers and search engines, and plan content that compounds instead of one-off posts.

topics.title: Google Ads Fundamentals (Search)
topics.description: Structure, keywords, and bidding for a Google Search campaign that doesn't burn budget.

topics.title: Display & Video Advertising

topics.title: Paid Social Advertising (Meta & LinkedIn)

topics.title: Inbound Marketing Fundamentals

topics.title: Email Marketing & Nurture Sequences
topics.description: Plan and write an email sequence that moves a lead toward a decision instead of just sitting in an inbox.

topics.title: Segmentation & Lifecycle Marketing

topics.title: A/B Testing & Experimentation
topics.description: Design a test that produces a real answer, and read the results without fooling yourself.

topics.title: Growth Loops & Funnel Metrics (AARRR)
topics.description: The AARRR funnel — acquisition, activation, retention, referral, revenue — and the growth-loop thinking that goes beyond a linear funnel.

topics.title: Growth Hacking Fundamentals
topics.description: The rapid-experimentation mindset behind fast-growing startups, and where it differs from traditional marketing.

topics.title: Attribution & Campaign Measurement
topics.description: Decide which marketing touchpoint gets credit for a conversion, and measure campaigns accordingly.
